name: Environmental Economics
summary: Research examines how pollution, climate, and environmental policy affect economic behavior, public health, and quality of life.
overview: Projects study the effects of weather and air quality on transportation choices, as well as how rainfall scarcity changes water collection and labor supply.

projects.title: Air Quality and Temperature Effects on Bike-Sharing Demand: Evidence from Washington, D.C.
projects.summary: Studies how weather and air pollution relate to bike-share ridership in Washington, D.C.

projects.title: Who Walks for Water? Water Consumption and Labor Supply Response to Rainfall Scarcity in Uganda
projects.summary: Studies how rainfall scarcity affects water collection and labor supply, including the burden on women and girls.
